implemented: Moved Meta/Ctrl-K, Meta/Ctrl-P, Meta/Ctrl-O and Meta/Ctrl-S resolution into the DOM-free shared UI keyboard contract.
Mapped the shared command IDs back to Electron command-palette, quick-switcher and save actions without changing the existing shortcut behavior.
Added an explicit keyboard-shortcuts UX marker and documented the KeyboardEvent/native-input mapping for a future Expo host.
limitations: The resolver and renderer wiring are unit- and contract-tested; a visible keyboard/focus run, screen-reader run, IME/RTL run and cross-platform interaction run remain pending.
